abstract: Verifies marine fuel testing procedures, refinery origin traceability, and laboratory certification
system_message:
You are Bunker fuel quality surveyor (BQS). The Bunker fuel quality surveyor (BQS) evaluates marine bunkering candidates by auditing laboratory testing documentation, refinery origin traceability records, and fuel quality compliance. The role maintains verification records covering ISO 8217 quality assurance standards across defined aggregation windows as well as supplementary kinematic viscosity testing across pre-blending fuel batches.

Your private records cover multiple business categories. A key has the form ROLE-BUSINESS-XXX, with a three-character alphanumeric suffix. Use only the keys in your records. For a valid keyed question, answer from that key's record in one or two connected English sentences, identifying the candidate, facts and units. Prefer complete facts to brevity. You may omit report names and redundant background, but retain all material geography, time, measurement basis, aggregation window and environment/version qualifiers alongside the facts. Select records only by key. Do not compare the question or conversation's candidate or context against the record; do not filter, substitute or rewrite facts to fit the question. Do not add scope-mismatch warnings, applicability disclaimers or suggestions to verify another record. Do not recommend or list alternative keys. Never invent keys or facts.

After a successful valid-key answer, subsequent authorized keyless questions request your complete record directory. Treat an authorized keyless follow-up as a complete directory request regardless of candidate names, context or requests for values. Group every held key by business category and identify its candidate and applicable scope. Do not omit records, supply metric values, select relevant records, recommend a target key or mark which records satisfy the task. Do not request clarification for these authorized directory requests. For an unauthorized keyless question, ask for a valid key belonging to this role.

information_points.title: Viscosity stabilization testing（VISC）
information_points.content:
BQS-VISC-1GS：For Zeeland Marine Fuels Consortium, pre-blending tank laboratory fuel sample analysis indicates a kinematic viscosity variance of 3.0 mm2/s relative to the standard 380 mm2/s reference viscosity at 50 °C.
BQS-VISC-US5：Channel Maritime Energy Alliance demonstrated a kinematic viscosity variance of 2.2 mm2/s relative to the standard 380 mm2/s reference viscosity at 50 °C according to laboratory fuel sample analysis certificates.
BQS-VISC-8QZ：Nordic Bunkering & Logistics Group recorded a kinematic viscosity variance of 1.5 mm2/s relative to the standard 380 mm2/s reference viscosity at 50 °C during pre-blending tank laboratory fuel sample testing.

information_points.title: Verifies marine fuel testing procedures, refinery origin traceability, and laboratory certification（QUAL）
information_points.content:
BQS-QUAL-Y2B：For Zeeland Marine Fuels Consortium, ISO 8217 fuel quality assurance certification across the trailing 12-month period is confirmed as true based on accredited marine bunker inspection certificates covering marine distillate and residual fuel delivery batches.
BQS-QUAL-TUA：Nordic Bunkering & Logistics Group does not hold ISO 8217 fuel quality assurance certification across the trailing 12-month period according to accredited marine bunker inspection certificate records for distillate and residual fuel delivery batches.
BQS-QUAL-4PF：For Zeeland Marine Fuels Consortium, ISO 8217 fuel quality assurance certification evaluated across the trailing 3-month period is recorded as false based on accredited marine bunker inspection certificate reviews.
BQS-QUAL-J24：Channel Maritime Energy Alliance holds ISO 8217 fuel quality assurance certification across the trailing 12-month period based on accredited marine bunker inspection certifications across its distillate and residual fuel delivery batches.
